name: net_script_mirror_boss
description: VUH-2252: the host's script calls on a mirrored boss reach the clients. Three instances with the player package's shipped defaults on a loopback relay, as in net_route_tt_hb_3p: two players hit the pause-menu crash VUH-2289 when the boss room's intro hold presses Start on a client still in GoA (runs vuh2252-boss-01 and -03). The host leads to the BC Thresholder fight (05/0B btl72), all three Soras fight, and the host and Friend1 are filmed at the same time for a side-by-side clip. The inject logs' per-second [script-mirror] lines are the message counts: every trap entry the host saw (seen), the mirrored-enemy calls it kept and sent, repeats that cost nothing on the wire, and what each client applied. Desync notices are recorded, not asserted (VUH-2270). Soras are protected (team 0).

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get(f'puppet{j}') or {}).get('active') for i in range(3) for j in range(2))
[log_count('[script-mirror] configure requested=1', i) for i in range(3)]==[1,1,1]
steps.message: The script mirror is not on with the shipped defaults

steps.expr: all(any(a.get('objectId')==353 and a['hp']>0 for a in enemies(i)) for i in range(3))
[m['line'] for m in log_matches(r'(?P<line>\[script-mirror\] host sec [^\r\n]*)', 0)]
[m['line'] for m in log_matches(r'(?P<line>\[script-mirror\] client sec [^\r\n]*)', 1)]
[m['line'] for m in log_matches(r'(?P<line>\[script-mirror\] client sec [^\r\n]*)', 2)]

[log_count('[script-mirror] swap-refused', 0), log_count('[script-mirror] client-refused', 1), log_count('[script-mirror] client-refused', 2), log_count('[script-mirror] admission refused', 1), log_count('[script-mirror] admission refused', 2)]
[runtime_log(i).count('Desync notice') - saved['notices_start'][i] for i in range(3)]

steps.message: A script-mirror pin or admission refused (see the inject logs)
